canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Galin Morai: 33-year-old woman, 161 cm (short), plus-size heavy construction with substantial natural mass, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: heart-shaped face; high cheekbones and softly lidded eyes; short rounded nose, wide mouth; no added facial mark. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: brown-chestnut, shaved-close-cropped, deliberate accent: one offset razor line. Wardrobe: layered-wrap, specifically overlapping wrap panels, an off-center waist tie, divided trousers, and soft boots; offset closures and narrow reinforced cuffs; bounded palette marigold-green. Visible personal details: a compact finger-line tattoo family; contrasting boot laces. Make a tattoo, scar, freckle field, or birthmark the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Color treatment: uses small rhythmic repeats of the palette. Pose cue: one thumb hooks lightly beneath the waist wrap while the other hand rests open. Include a tiny cloth-wrapped notebook only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
